summary: Glacier National Park's 60-foot steel Red Eagle lookout, moved in 1959 or 1960 from Swiftcurrent Ridge and gone by 1986; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1986 per WillhiteWeb and a Glacier blog; a Montana list says removed; no source describes what remains

events.note: Glacier blog gives 1960 as the build year; WillhiteWeb says a 60-foot steel tower was moved here from Swiftcurrent Ridge in 1960
firelookout.com says the tower was moved here from Swiftcurrent Ridge in 1959
WillhiteWeb and the blog say destroyed in 1986; firelookout.com says gone in 1986; the Montana list says removed

evidence.supports: a latecomer to Glacier's lookout system
evidence.quote: A latecomer to the lookout system of Glacier National Park

evidence.supports: 2 miles south-southwest of Saint Mary, Glacier National Park

evidence.quote: In 1960, a 60-foot steel tower was moved from Swiftcurrent Ridge to this location.
One was the Red Eagle Lookout, a 60-foot steel tower that was built in 1960, but destroyed in 1986.

evidence.supports: Red Eagle one of two notable exceptions to the park's usual design
evidence.quote: There were two notable exceptions to this basic design, however.

evidence.supports: most park lookouts were two-story wooden structures with a cab on top
evidence.quote: Most of the lookouts in the park had the same basic design; a two story wooden structure with a windowless dirt floor storage area, topped by a 14 x 14 foot ‘cab’

evidence.supports: Montana lookout list gives status Removed

resolved_conflicts.field: year the tower reached Red Eagle
resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1959 for the move from Swiftcurrent Ridge; WillhiteWeb gives 1960 for the move, and the Glacier blog gives 1960 as the build year. The story reports both.

resolved_conflicts.field: how the tower left the site
resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb and the blog say destroyed in 1986; the Montana list says removed. No source gives the method.

sources.title: The Fire Lookouts of Glacier National Park

notes_for_editor: Record coordinates (48.65442, -113.54872) are about 10 km from the FFLA list (48.71739, -113.44785); not changed. WillhiteWeb and the Glacier blog are secondary; a Montana Memory Project caption seen only in search (mtmemory.org node 5437) was not verified on its page, so it is not cited. No staffing, access or present-day source was found.
